Findings

Home projects in all districts, all completion years. Reference date 24 Nov 2026.

  • Homes with a flat count (Residential or Mixed): 5,926 of 11,186 active projects, 5,77,529 flats in total.
  • Completing in 2027: 1,132 home projects with 90,517 flats. This is the fit-out window: call first.
  • Completing in 2028: 708 more home projects with 1,06,147 flats. Talk to the promoter now, before the fit-out plan closes.
  • Completion dates in 2025 or 2026, still active on RERA: 2,047 home projects with 1,15,604 flats. Most are late, or done and not updated: check the site first.
  • Projects of more than 500 flats: 92 of 1,840 in 2027 and 2028, with 53.2% of the flats.
  • Top taluks for 2027 and 2028: Gandipet (Ranga Reddy, 37,742 flats), Serilingampally (Ranga Reddy, 21,906 flats) and Ramachandrapuram (Sangareddy, 21,774 flats).
  • Top promoters for 2027 and 2028: Aparna Constructions And Estates PVT LTD (10,383 flats in 9 projects), Rajapushpa Properties Pvt. Ltd. (6,494 flats in 2 projects) and Ramky Estates And Farms LTD (4,449 flats in 5 projects).
  • 1,377 promoters have flats in 2027 or 2028. The top 10 hold 21.6% of them.
  • Tier A leads (score 200 or more): 334 projects, with 3,01,320 flats. Sort the explorer by Lead to see the list.
